description: Embedded-language grammars this extension bundles to highlight `:: lang ::` verbatim blocks. Each parser WASM comes from an npm dependency (`npm` / `wasm` below); each `highlights.scm` is VENDORED next to this file because none of the prebuilt-WASM packages ship queries. `upstream*` records exactly which grammar revision the vendored query was taken from — it is the same revision the npm package's WASM was built from (`lumis.upstreamVersion` / `lumis.rev` in the package's own package.json), so query node names always match the parser. Refreshing a grammar is a deliberate two-step edit: bump the npm pin, then re-vendor `highlights.scm` + `LICENSE` from the new `upstreamRev`, and update this file to match. `app-bin/stage-embedded-grammars.mjs` reads this manifest to stage `resources/embedded-grammars/<name>/`; `test/unit/embeddedGrammars.test.ts` fails if manifest, npm pin and staged output ever disagree.
